title: Chough change approve relays a human's approval of a change definition to SpecSync with a required citation (REQ-cli-071, DRIVE-20)
description: chough change approve relays a human's approval of a change definition to SpecSync with a required citation (REQ-cli-071, DRIVE-20)
acceptance_criteria: chough change approve refuses before SpecSync runs without --actor, --words or --where, or with one of them blank. With all three, it runs specsync change approve <id> --actor <actor> --note <note>, where the note carries relayed=pi chat, decided-by, words, where and recorded-by joined by '; ', and --note appends its value; without --recorded-by the note names chough <version>. SpecSync's standard output, standard error and exit code pass through unchanged.

answers.constraints: specs/cli/cli.3md: write tasks.md without unchecked boxes, because change check refuses them; treat the delta as frozen once approved
